abstract: This paper documents that firms experience a decline in innovation following the staggered adoption of salary history ban legislation (SHBs), which prohibits employers from asking job candidates about salary histories in the hiring process. We develop a theoretical model and hypothesize that SHBs impose higher informational asymmetries in the labor market and thus cause more severe adverse selection when employers attempt to hire inventors. Consistent with this hypothesis, we find that after SHBs, firms hire fewer inventors relative to their total workforce and, at the firm-year level, the newly hired inventor pool exhibits lower average innovation performance. Inventor-level tests further show that firms become more selective among the inventors they do hire. We also show that the adverse effect of SHBs on innovation is more pronounced for firms in states with stronger labor market protection. This paper outlines the unintended consequences of labor regulation and information restriction on corporate innovation.
abstract_zh: 本文记录了在逐步实施薪资历史禁令立法（SHBs）后，企业创新活动出现下滑的现象。该立法禁止雇主在招聘过程中询问求职者的薪资历史。我们构建了一个理论模型，并提出假设：SHBs加剧了劳动力市场中的信息不对称，从而在雇主试图招聘发明家时引发更严重的逆向选择问题。与这一假设相符的是，我们发现实施SHBs后，企业相对于其总员工规模招聘的发明家数量减少，并且在企业-年度层面上，新招聘的发明家群体的平均创新绩效较低。发明家层面的测试进一步表明，企业在实际招聘的发明家中变得更加挑剔。我们还发现，SHBs对创新的不利影响在劳动力市场保护更强的州份企业中更为显著。本文揭示了劳动法规与信息限制对企业创新的意外后果。
title: The unintended real effect of salary history bans: The case of innovation
title_zh: 薪酬历史禁令的意外实际效应：以创新为例

abstract: We study whether misconduct by firms and investment advisers declines around a quasi-natural experiment created by the staggered launch of Twitter accounts by regional offices of the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). Even though the tweets repackage information available on the SEC’s website, we find a reduction in opportunistic insider trading and financial misreporting for firms, and a reduction in customer complaints against investment advisers. Consistent with the tweets making enforcement actions more salient and widely disseminated, we find the decline in misconduct to be cross-sectionally related to Twitter following and engagement, the fraction of retail clients, tweet content, and investment in compliance. In addition, we find Twitter adoption expands press coverage of the SEC’s work and increases stock market reactions to SEC enforcement actions. Our results suggest that regulators’ use of social media, a relatively low-cost intervention, deters misconduct.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了在美国证券交易委员会（SEC）各地区办事处陆续开通Twitter账户这一准自然实验背景下，企业及投资顾问的不当行为是否有所减少。尽管这些推文重新包装了SEC网站上已有的信息，我们仍观察到机会主义内幕交易和企业财务错报有所减少，同时针对投资顾问的客户投诉也相应下降。与推文使执法行动更加显著且广泛传播的假设一致，我们发现不当行为的减少与Twitter关注度及互动、零售客户比例、推文内容以及合规投入呈横截面相关。此外，Twitter的采用扩大了媒体对SEC工作的报道范围，并增强了股市对SEC执法行动的反应。我们的研究结果表明，监管机构利用社交媒体这一成本相对较低的干预手段，能够有效遏制不当行为。
title: Regulating via Social Media: Deterrence Effects of the SEC’s Use of Twitter
title_zh: 通过社交媒体进行监管：美国证券交易委员会使用Twitter的威慑效应

abstract: In simple choice, slower decisions tend to indicate proximity to indifference and thus less predictable choice. In complex situations, some studies have argued that slower decisions indicate more reasoning and thus more optimal decisions. However, those studies rely on games where the optimal responses are debatable – they depend on agents’ beliefs or social preferences. Thus, it is unclear whether being slow is a good or bad sign. Here, we examine whether fast decisions are more or less optimal in high and low complexity, zero-sum games with dominant strategies and limited social-preference concerns. We study repeated 2-person p-beauty contests, where halfway through the experiment we switch the multiplier, changing the dominant strategy. Only 33% of subjects correctly adjusted after the switch, an indication of understanding the dominant strategy. Those who continued to play the dominant strategy showed a decrease in response time (RT) upon playing the dominant strategy, while those who later switched away from the dominant strategy did not. Contrary to the predictions for complex games, subjects exhibited negative correlations between RT and optimal choice, both in the early rounds and after the switch. Thus, we find no support for the notion that slower decisions result in better choices.
abstract_zh: 在简单选择中，较慢的决策往往表明接近无差异状态，从而预测性较低。在复杂情境下，一些研究认为较慢的决策意味着更多的推理，因此更可能产生最优决策。然而，这些研究依赖于最优反应存在争议的博弈——它们取决于参与者的信念或社会偏好。因此，尚不清楚决策缓慢是积极信号还是消极信号。在此，我们考察在具有主导策略且社会偏好关注有限的高、低复杂度零和博弈中，快速决策是否更优或更劣。我们研究了重复进行的两人p-美容竞赛，在实验中途切换乘数，从而改变主导策略。仅有33%的受试者在切换后正确调整，这表明他们理解了主导策略。那些继续采用主导策略的受试者在执行主导策略时反应时间（RT）有所下降，而那些后来偏离主导策略的受试者则没有表现出这种下降。与复杂博弈的预测相反，受试者在早期轮次及切换后均表现出反应时间与最优选择之间的负相关。因此，我们没有发现支持“较慢决策导致更好选择”这一观点的证据。
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
source_issue: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Volume 250
title: Does slow strategizing indicate optimal behavior or uncertainty?
title_zh: 缓慢的战略制定意味着最优行为还是不确定性？

abstract: Green innovation is crucial for sustainable corporate development; however, existing literature provides limited insight into how energy-derivatives market development (EDMD) affects corporate green innovation behaviour. Using the official launch of the Shanghai crude oil futures contract as an exogenous shock, this study investigates whether EDMD enhances Chinese corporate green innovation. Using a panel of A-share listed firms from 2013 to 2023 (comprising 22,179 firm-year observations) and a continuous difference-in-differences (DID) design, this study has found that the introduction of crude oil futures in China significantly elevates corporate green innovation levels. This result was robust to a battery of checks. The mechanism analysis revealed that EDMD promoted green innovation by alleviating financial constraints. Managerial myopia and heightened information asymmetry attenuate this positive relationship. Heterogeneity analyses have indicated that the promoting effect is more pronounced among state-owned enterprises, highly polluting firms, and firms in which the roles of the CEO and board chairs are separated. Overall, this study provides micro-level empirical evidence of the nexus between EDMD and corporate green innovation and offers relevant insights into the design of energy policies. KEYWORDS: Energy-derivatives market development corporate green innovation crude oil futures financial constraints JEL CLASSIFICATION: G18 G30 O31
abstract_zh: 绿色创新对企业可持续发展至关重要；然而，现有文献对能源衍生品市场发展如何影响企业绿色创新行为的探讨十分有限。本研究以中国上海原油期货合约的正式上市作为外生冲击，考察能源衍生品市场发展是否促进了中国企业的绿色创新。基于2013至2023年间A股上市公司的面板数据（包含22，179个公司-年度观测值），并采用连续型双重差分模型，研究发现中国原油期货的推出显著提升了企业绿色创新水平，且该结论在一系列稳健性检验后依然成立。机制分析表明，能源衍生品市场发展通过缓解企业融资约束促进了绿色创新，而管理层短视与信息不对称程度的加剧则会削弱这一正向效应。异质性分析显示，在国有企业、高污染企业以及董事长与总经理两职分离的企业中，该促进效应更为显著。总体而言，本研究为能源衍生品市场发展与企业绿色创新之间的关联提供了微观层面的经验证据，并为能源政策设计提供了相关启示。关键词：能源衍生品市场发展；企业绿色创新；原油期货；融资约束 JEL分类号：G18 G30 O31

title: Energy-derivatives market development and corporate green innovation: evidence from the launch of Shanghai crude oil futures
title_zh: 能源衍生品市场发展与企业绿色创新——来自上海原油期货上市的实证证据

abstract: Climate extremes and conflict risks may co‐occur in the same regions, particularly where agrifood systems are fragile, exposing vulnerable communities to multiple shocks. However, the extent to which these shocks co‐occur depends on local contextual factors. To inform the prioritization of interventions aimed at mitigating compound risks and strengthening agrifood system resilience, this paper examines where, and to what extent, climate extremes, food price volatility, and conflict events overlap, in Northern Nigeria, a region characterized by a high concentration of major agricultural markets and sufficiently rich data to support long‐panel analysis across multiple commodities. Using data from 52 retail agricultural markets between 2002 and 2023, we estimate 9680 local regressions that permutate over a breadth of variables and their combinations. In doing so, we relax the constraint on co‐occurrence allowing the measure to vary across locations to capture local specificity. Results reveal significant co‐occurrences of climate extremes (especially drought), food price volatility (especially in locally important commodities), and increased intensity of conflict in the study area. In specific hotspots, the estimated intensity of co‐occurrence is up to five times higher than in other locations, indicating a substantial within‐country heterogeneity in exposure to compound risks. Our findings suggest the need for localized evidence to guide the targeting of interventions and to identify priority locations for investigating the root cause of vulnerability to compound risks.
abstract_zh: 气候极端事件与冲突风险可能在同一地区同时发生，尤其是在农业粮食系统脆弱的区域，使本已脆弱的社区面临多重冲击。然而，这些冲击同时发生的程度取决于当地的情境因素。为帮助确定旨在缓解复合风险、增强农业粮食系统韧性的干预措施的优先顺序，本文考察了尼日利亚北部——一个以主要农产品市场高度集中、且拥有足够丰富的数据支持多种商品长期面板分析为特征的地区——气候极端事件、粮食价格波动和冲突事件在何处以及何种程度上发生重叠。利用2002年至2023年间52个零售农产品市场的数据，我们估计了9680个局部回归模型，这些模型对多种变量及其组合进行置换。通过这一方法，我们放宽了同时发生的约束条件，使度量随地点变化以捕捉地方特异性。结果显示，研究区域内气候极端事件（尤其是干旱）、粮食价格波动（尤其是当地重要商品）与冲突强度增加之间存在显著的同时发生现象。在特定热点区域，估计的同时发生强度比其他地区高出多达五倍，表明复合风险暴露在国家内部存在显著的异质性。我们的研究结果表明，需要基于地方层面的证据来指导干预措施的精准定位，并识别优先调查复合风险脆弱性根源的地点。
title: Spatial Co‐Occurrence of Climate Extremes, Food Price Volatility, and Conflicts in Northern Nigeria: Implications for Geotargeting
title_zh: 尼日利亚北部气候极端事件、粮食价格波动与冲突的空间共现：对地理精准定位的启示

abstract: Despite a long-standing literature documenting wage differentials between public and private sector workers in the US, the factors underlying these differences remain only partially understood. Existing studies examining human capital explanations for public-private wage differentials have largely focused on general labour market experience and firm tenure, with limited attention to industry and occupation-specific human capital. This study examines the extent to which different forms of human capital: general, firm-specific, industry-specific, and occupation-specific, which contribute to public-private wage differentials using data from the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth 1979 (NLSY79) from 2008 to 2018. Employing Oaxaca decomposition, ordinary least squares, and random-effects models, the results show that human capital explains a substantial share of the observed public-sector wage premium. Firm-specific human capital is the largest contributor, followed by industry-specific human capital, while general human capital has a smaller but statistically significant effect. In contrast, occupation-specific human capital does not explain the wage differential once unobserved individual heterogeneity is taken into account. The findings are robust to propensity score matching and alternative sample restrictions. Overall, differences in the accumulation of specific human capital, particularly within firms and industries, help explain the persistence of public-private wage differentials in the US. KEYWORDS: Firm-specific human capital industry-specific human capital Occupational Human Capital sectoral wage differentials JEL CLASSIFICATION: J24 J31 J45 J62 Acknowledgements The authors acknowledge the use of Generative AI and AI-assisted technologies during the manuscript preparation process to improve the quality of the language and intelligibility.
abstract_zh: 尽管已有大量文献记录了美国公共部门与私营部门劳动者之间的工资差异，但造成这些差异的因素至今仍未得到充分理解。现有研究在考察人力资本对公私部门工资差异的解释时，主要聚焦于一般劳动力市场经验和企业任期，而对行业和职业特定人力资本的关注有限。本研究利用1979年全国青年纵向调查（NLSY79）2008年至2018年的数据，考察不同类型的人力资本——一般性、企业特定、行业特定和职业特定——在多大程度上解释了公私部门工资差异。通过采用Oaxaca分解、普通最小二乘法和随机效应模型，结果显示人力资本解释了所观察到的公共部门工资溢价中的相当大份额。企业特定人力资本是最大的贡献因素，其次是行业特定人力资本，而一般性人力资本的影响较小但具有统计显著性。相比之下，在考虑未观测到的个体异质性后，职业特定人力资本并不能解释工资差异。研究结果在倾向得分匹配和替代样本限制下依然稳健。总体而言，特定人力资本积累的差异，尤其是企业和行业层面的人力资本积累差异，有助于解释美国公私部门工资差异的持续存在。关键词：企业特定人力资本；行业特定人力资本；职业人力资本；部门工资差异 JEL分类：J24 J31 J45 J62 致谢 作者感谢在稿件准备过程中使用生成式人工智能和AI辅助技术以提升语言质量和可读性。
title: Human capital and public-private wage differentials in the US: evidence from the NLSY79 (2008–2018)
title_zh: 美国人力资本与公私部门工资差异：来自NLSY79（2008—2018）的证据

abstract: Fund managers may adjust portfolio styles to pursue short-term private benefits, with implications for investor welfare and market stability. Using a sample of 3,243 Chinese equity-oriented mutual funds from 2012 to 2022, this paper examines the determinants and performance consequences of style drift by separating two behaviours: self-drift, defined as intertemporal variation in a fund’s style relative to its own history, and benchmark-drift, defined as deviation from the prospectus-stated style. This paper shows that self-drift is associated with two distinct motives—hot-chasing by underperforming funds and value-seeking by top performers—while benchmark-drift is predominantly driven by hot-chasing among underperformers. Consistent with these channels, the link between self-drift and future performance hinges on past performance, whereas benchmark-drift is followed by markedly lower future returns. Further evidence indicates that compensation incentives, rather than career concerns, are the primary driver of style drift. Although investors can distinguish the two forms, they disproportionately allocate capital to self-drift funds, suggesting limited recognition of their heterogeneous underlying motives. KEYWORDS: Self-drift benchmark-drift hot-chasing value-seeking fund performance JEL CLASSIFICATION: G11 G23 G41
abstract_zh: 基金经理可能为了追求短期私人利益而调整投资组合风格，这对投资者福利和市场稳定性具有重要影响。本文以2012年至2022年间3，243只中国股票型共同基金为样本，通过区分两种行为——自我漂移（定义为基金风格相对于自身历史的时间变化）和基准漂移（定义为偏离招募说明书所述风格）——考察了风格漂移的决定因素及其业绩后果。研究发现，自我漂移与两种不同的动机相关——业绩不佳基金的追逐热点行为和顶尖基金的寻求价值行为——而基准漂移则主要由业绩不佳者的追逐热点行为驱动。与这些渠道一致，自我漂移与未来业绩之间的关系取决于过往业绩，而基准漂移之后则伴随着显著较低的未来回报。进一步证据表明，薪酬激励而非职业担忧是风格漂移的主要驱动因素。尽管投资者能够区分这两种形式，但他们将资本不成比例地配置给自我漂移基金，这表明投资者对其异质性潜在动机的认知有限。关键词：自我漂移 基准漂移 追逐热点 寻求价值 基金业绩 JEL分类：G11 G23 G41

title: Style drift in China’s capital market: hot-chasing or value-seeking?
title_zh: 中国资本市场风格漂移：追热还是寻值？

abstract: This study examines the relationship between classroom diversity in family occupational backgrounds and student academic performance using a randomized classroom assignment framework. We find that students achieve higher test scores when their classmates come from more diverse backgrounds, as measured by their fathers’ occupations. We also provide suggestive evidence consistent with a role for parental involvement. In more diverse classrooms, parents have higher expectations and stricter discipline at home. These patterns are stronger when students live at home and when parent meeting attendance rates are high. Overall, the results suggest that classroom peer diversity may influence student outcomes partly through parental responses. KEYWORDS: Diversity student achievement Peer Effects parental involvement JEL CLASSIFICATION: I21 I24 J13
abstract_zh: 本研究利用随机分班框架，探讨了家庭职业背景的课堂多样性与学生学业表现之间的关系。研究发现，当同学的家庭背景更加多元（以父亲职业为衡量标准）时，学生的考试成绩更高。我们还提供了与家长参与作用相一致的初步证据。在更加多元的课堂中，家长对孩子抱有更高的期望，并在家中实施更严格的纪律。这些效应在学生住校以及家长会出席率较高的情况下更为显著。总体而言，研究结果表明，课堂同伴多样性可能部分通过家长的反应影响学生学业成果。关键词：多样性 学生成就 同伴效应 家长参与 JEL分类：I21 I24 J13
title: Beyond student peer effects: class diversity, test scores, and the role of parents
title_zh: 超越学生同伴效应：班级多样性、考试成绩与家长的作用

abstract: Land use planning, as a scientific discipline, is a nexus among philosophy of science, planning theories and methodological frameworks. It is built primarily upon two distinct schools of thought, landscape ecology and land ecology, each supported by different ontological roots and epistemic commitments. The methodologies in this domain have been extensively developed and refined at a technical level; however, the underlying philosophies and ethical implications remain largely implicit. Consequently, spatial planning practices can potentially be stuck in a path-dependent cycle, where ethical blind spots and methodological numbness can arise. The current study analyzes how such foundations are embedded within the theories and methodologies of influential schools of thought in land use planning, a situation which currently constitutes a research gap. We address this gap by examining the epistemological and ethical underpinnings, and their methodological and planning implications, of both schools of thought. More specifically, our examination compares the way these planning approaches conceptualize, componentize and synthesize the land for planning and how they treat integration of socioeconomic and ecological data and delineate land units. Our analysis also shows how they rely on inductive and deductive reasoning, or causal and correlational analysis and how methodological choices can affect the level of holism/reductionism and non-anthropocentrism/anthropocentrism in the methodologies. This philosophical and analytical study contributes to advancing discussion and methodological innovations in land use science.
abstract_zh: 土地利用规划作为一门科学学科，是科学哲学、规划理论与方法论框架的交汇点。它主要建立在两种不同的思想流派之上，即景观生态学与土地生态学，各自依托不同的本体论根源和认识论承诺。该领域的方法论在技术层面已得到广泛发展与完善；然而，其背后的哲学基础与伦理意涵在很大程度上仍处于隐含状态。因此，空间规划实践可能陷入路径依赖的循环之中，从而产生伦理盲区与方法论麻木。本研究分析了这些基础如何嵌入土地利用规划中有影响力的思想流派的理论与方法之中，而这一现状目前构成了研究空白。我们通过考察这两种思想流派的认识论与伦理基础及其方法论和规划意涵来填补这一空白。更具体而言，我们的比较分析审视了这些规划方法在概念化、要素化及综合化土地以供规划之用的方式，以及它们如何处理社会经济与生态数据的整合并划定土地单元。我们的分析还揭示了它们如何依赖归纳与演绎推理，或因果与相关分析，以及方法论选择如何影响方法论中的整体主义/还原主义和非人类中心主义/人类中心主义水平。这项哲学与分析性研究有助于推动土地利用科学领域的讨论深化与方法论创新。
title: Understanding land use philosophy through ontology and epistemology
title_zh: 从本体论与认识论视角理解土地利用哲学

abstract: Do individuals at war avoid news about outgroup victims? Would such news affect them if they were exposed to it? We study Israelis and Jordanians during the 2023-2025 Gaza war. Four findings stand out. First, individuals are substantially less willing to read about outgroup than ingroup civilian victims. Second, news avoidance is driven less by instrumental considerations or universal affective factors, and more by social identity and group norms. Third, reading about outgroup victims increases knowledge, fosters empathy toward the outgroup, and affects policy positions. Finally, these effects arise even among individuals who would rather avoid such news.
abstract_zh: 战争中的个体会回避关于外群体受害者的新闻吗？如果接触到这类新闻，又会否对他们产生影响？我们以2023-2025年加沙战争期间的以色列人和约旦人为研究对象。研究得出四项主要发现。第一，个体阅读外群体平民受害者新闻的意愿显著低于阅读内群体受害者新闻。第二，新闻回避行为更多由社会身份和群体规范驱动，而非出于工具性考量或普遍的情感因素。第三，阅读关于外群体受害者的新闻能增进知识、培养对外群体的同理心，并影响政策立场。最后，这些效应即便在那些宁愿回避此类新闻的个体中也会显现。
title: Paying Not to Know: News Avoidance in Times of War
title_zh: 花钱不知：战争时期的新闻回避

abstract: Digital technologies have transformed the news landscape, shifting consumption from print media toward online providers. This has allowed news outlets to collect richer data on individual readers, and to use those data both to tailor the news a reader sees— which stories appear and how they are framed—and to sell more precisely targeted advertising. Online news outlets also increasingly recruit readers from social media, amplifying incentives to capture reader attention through sensationalized stories and other techniques to increase engagement. Generative AI is likely to accelerate this trend by lowering the cost of personalizing news. Whether cheaper production and finer personalization raise or lower consumer welfare depends on how closely the objectives firms maximize are aligned with the underlying preferences of consumers. This review studies how the shift toward online news consumption affects both the supply and the demand for news and draws potential implications for consumer welfare.
abstract_zh: 数字技术已深刻改变了新闻业的格局，将消费从纸质媒体转向在线提供商。这使得新闻机构能够收集关于个体读者的更丰富数据，并利用这些数据既定制读者所见的新闻——包括哪些报道出现及其呈现方式——又销售更精准定向的广告。在线新闻提供商还日益从社交媒体吸引读者，这加剧了通过耸人听闻的报道及其他提升参与度的技巧来捕捉读者注意力的激励。生成式人工智能可能通过降低新闻个性化成本而加速这一趋势。更廉价的生产与更精细的个性化是提升还是降低消费者福利，取决于企业所最大化的目标与消费者潜在偏好的契合程度。本综述考察了向在线新闻消费的转变如何影响新闻的供给与需求，并探讨其对消费者福利的潜在影响。
title: News Consumption in the Digital Age
title_zh: 数字时代的新闻消费

abstract: Racial disparities in criminal justice outcomes are well documented. However, there is little evidence on whether the pairing of prosecutors and defendants contributes to these disparities. This paper tests for race-pairing effects in convictions by prosecutors. I leverage conditionally as-good-as-random assignment of misdemeanor cases using administrative data from New York County’s Early Case Assessment Bureau. I find little evidence of race-pairing effects overall or for drug, person, and other offenses. In contrast, I find a robust 5 percentage point (8 percent) race-pairing effect for property crimes. The underlying pattern is driven by differences in outcomes for Black defendants, while conviction rates for White defendants are nearly identical across prosecutor race. Results appear driven by reduced use of adjournments in contemplation of dismissal, a discretionary form of prosecutorial leniency.
abstract_zh: 刑事司法结果中的种族差异已有充分记录。然而，关于检察官与被告的配对是否促成这些差异的证据却寥寥无几。本文利用纽约县早期案件评估局的行政数据，检验了轻罪案件中检察官与被告种族配对效应。总体而言，或在毒品、人身及其他犯罪类别中，我未发现明显的种族配对效应。相反，对于财产犯罪，我发现了稳健的5个百分点（8%）的种族配对效应。这一潜在模式主要由黑人被告结果的差异驱动，而白人被告的定罪率在不同种族的检察官之间几乎相同。结果似乎源于对“延期驳回”使用的减少，这是一种检察官自由裁量权的宽大处理形式。
title: Do prosecutor and defendant race pairings matter? Evidence from random assignment
title_zh: 检察官与被告的种族配对是否重要？来自随机分配的证据

abstract: Several recent constitution-making processes have been celebrated for being participatory, inclusive, and representative. However, many of these processes also failed. We theorize that aspects of these kinds of constitutional drafting processes could reduce the probability of constitutional success. To show why, we construct a “Constitution Drafting game” (CD game) in which representatives from different interest groups must draft a constitution. We consider the case where the probability of constitutional success is single peaked, but the value from successful adoption is increasing in the degree of issue protection chosen. The drafting process then leads to protection choices that are above those which maximize the odds of constitutional success. Moreover, when the CD game is equivalent to a “nice aggregative game”, as in Acemoglu and Jensen (2013), the maximum and minimum equilibrium probabilities of constitutional success are decreasing in the number of representatives. Within a more specific game structure, we show that the symmetric equilibrium degree of protection chosen by each representative is decreasing in the number of interest groups represented, while the total degree of protection is increasing in it, leading to lower probabilities of constitutional success. We explain how optimism can exacerbate the degree of protection chosen by each party.
abstract_zh: 近期若干制宪过程因参与性、包容性和代表性而备受赞誉。然而，其中许多过程也以失败告终。我们提出理论，认为这类宪法起草过程的某些特征可能降低宪法成功的概率。为阐明原因，我们构建了一个“宪法起草博弈”（CD博弈），其中来自不同利益集团的代表必须起草一部宪法。我们考虑宪法成功概率呈单峰状，但成功采纳的价值随所选议题保护程度递增的情形。起草过程因此导致保护程度的选择高于最大化宪法成功概率的水平。此外，当CD博弈等同于Acemoglu和Jensen（2013）所定义的“良性聚合博弈”时，宪法成功的最大和最小均衡概率随代表人数的增加而递减。在更具体的博弈结构中，我们证明每位代表所选的对称均衡保护程度随所代表利益集团数量的增加而递减，而总保护程度则随其增加而递增，从而导致宪法成功概率降低。我们解释了乐观情绪如何加剧各方所选保护程度。
title: Constitutional drafting processes and constitutional success
title_zh: 宪法起草过程与宪法成功

title: Electoral cycles and consumption in India
title_zh: 印度选举周期与消费

abstract: This paper estimates a dynamic model of annuitisation in which individuals hold subjective survival beliefs that may differ from their actual mortality risk. I show that biased survival beliefs reduce annuitisation at retirement but generate additional annuity demand at older ages. Overall, individuals under-annuitise by 10.1% during retirement and delay the average age of annuitisation by 3.7 years relative to the objective benchmark. The average welfare loss resulting from biased survival beliefs is equivalent to 2.9% of retirement-age assets. About 31% of this loss is attributable to pessimism about survival, while the remaining 69% reflects misperceptions of how mortality risk increases with age. Counterfactual policy experiments suggest that subsidies for annuity purchases early in retirement financed by taxing later purchases would improve welfare.
abstract_zh: 本文估计了一个动态年金化模型，其中个体持有的主观生存信念可能与其实际死亡风险存在差异。我证明，偏差的生存信念会降低退休时的年金化程度，但在较高年龄段却会产生额外的年金需求。总体而言，个体在退休期间的年金化程度比客观基准低10.1%，并将平均年金化年龄推迟了3.7年。由偏差生存信念导致的平均福利损失相当于退休年龄资产的2.9%。其中约31%的损失归因于对生存的悲观态度，而其余69%则反映了对死亡风险随年龄增长方式的误解。反事实政策实验表明，通过征税后期年金购买来补贴退休早期年金购买的补贴政策将改善福利。
title: Subjective Survival Expectations and Annuitisation Decisions
title_zh: 主观生存预期与年金化决策

abstract: This paper estimates two measures of human capital externalities. By incorporating externalities into an overlapping-generations model of human capital accumulation with Compulsory Schooling Laws (CSL), we show that human capital externalities can be estimated from the effects of CSL for one generation on wages of other generations. Using an instrumental-variable strategy deduced from the model, we find one more year of average schooling at the U.S. state level raises individual wages by 6-8%. Taking this reduced-form estimate into account, we find the elasticity of a typical firm’s productivity with respect to the average human capital of an economy is 0.121.
abstract_zh: 本文估算了人力资本外部性的两种度量。通过将外部性纳入一个包含义务教育法（CSL）的人力资本积累重叠世代模型中，我们表明，人力资本外部性可以从一代人的CSL对其他代际工资的影响中估计出来。利用从模型推导出的工具变量策略，我们发现美国州级平均教育年限每增加一年，个人工资提高6%-8%。考虑到这一简化形式估计，我们发现典型企业生产率对经济体平均人力资本的弹性为0.121。
title: Estimating Aggregate Human Capital Externalities
title_zh: 估计总体人力资本外部性

title: Corrigendum to “Locus of control, climate change adaptation and perception: Evidence from rural Ethiopia” [World Dev. 208 (2026) 107525]
title_zh: 更正启事：“控制点、气候变化适应与认知：来自埃塞俄比亚农村的证据” [World Dev. 208 (2026) 107525]

abstract: This paper analyzes the macroeconomic consequences of bank market power under corporate earnings-based borrowing constraints. By embedding a Cournot banking structure within a Kiyotaki-Moore framework, we uncover a sharp structural reversal: while credit market power dampens the fire-sale multiplier under traditional asset-backed constraints, it amplifies that multiplier under earnings covenants. The endogenous lending markup directly inflates debt-service obligations, tightening borrowers’ cash-flow constraints, forcing deeper asset misallocations and severe aggregate output contractions. Fostering banking competition and relaxing countercyclical covenants act as structural complements, compressing spreads and maximizing real capital retention during financial distress.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了在企业盈利为基础的借贷约束下，银行市场势力的宏观经济后果。通过将古诺银行业结构嵌入Kiyotaki-Moore框架，我们揭示了一个显著的结构性反转：在传统资产支持约束下，信贷市场势力抑制了火灾销售乘数，而在盈利契约下则放大了这一乘数。内生贷款加成直接推高了偿债义务，收紧借款人的现金流约束，迫使资产错配加深，并导致严重的总产出收缩。促进银行业竞争与放松逆周期契约在结构上互为补充，压缩利差并在金融困境期间最大化实际资本保留。
title: Bank market power and fire-sale amplification under earnings-based constraints
title_zh: 银行市场势力与基于收益约束下的抛售放大效应

abstract: Behavioral interventions, for example, through the use of incentives and information, are widely used by policymakers to induce welfare‐improving behavior. When these interventions are used in specific contexts such as environmental conservation, individual knowledge, experience, and attitudes can lead to motivational crowding and may limit their efficacy. In this article, we investigate how incentives and information affect the behavior of recreational hunters in Alberta when tasked with curbing the spread of chronic wasting disease (CWD), a deadly wildlife disease. Embedded in a framed multiple‐threshold public goods game, we test hunters’ responses to various real‐world policy instruments designed to increase hunting trips. We find that hunters take more trips (increase their contribution to the public good) in response to monetary incentives framed as extra hunting tags but do not respond to direct monetary rewards. These findings advance our knowledge of how incentives can lead to motivational crowding and provide meaningful policy guidance for wildlife management and other environmental programs.
abstract_zh: 行为干预，例如通过激励和信息手段，被政策制定者广泛用于引导福利改善行为。当这些干预措施应用于环境保护等特定情境时，个体知识、经验和态度可能导致动机挤兑，从而限制其效果。本文探讨了在阿尔伯塔省，激励和信息如何影响休闲猎人在遏制慢性消耗性疾病（CWD）——一种致命野生动物疾病——传播过程中的行为。通过嵌入一个框架化的多阈值公共物品博弈实验，我们测试了猎人对旨在增加狩猎出行次数的各种现实政策工具的反应。研究发现，猎人在面对以额外狩猎标签形式呈现的货币激励时，会增加出行次数（即增加对公共物品的贡献），但对直接货币奖励并无响应。这些发现深化了我们对激励如何引发动机挤兑的理解，并为野生动物管理及其他环境项目提供了有意义的政策指导。
title: Incentives and motivational crowding to address chronic wasting disease: An experiment with Alberta hunters
title_zh: 激励与动机挤占应对慢性消耗性疾病：一项针对阿尔伯塔省猎人的实验

abstract: The idea that people want to go to where the jobs are is intuitive, yet is absent from the standard quantitative spatial modelling approach in which location choices are guided by prices, without reference to quantities (the number of jobs in a place). The purpose of this paper is to fill this gap by making jobs, as well as places, the objects of household choice. This involves minor change to the modelling approach used in the literature and provides a simple description of labour market matching. Similar modification of the modelling of firms’ location choices captures the idea that these are shaped by both wage costs and the availability of workers with appropriate skill. These modifications yield powerful agglomeration forces, as workers’ location choices become positively influenced by the number of jobs in a place, and firms’ decision are shaped by the number of workers with appropriate skills. Results are established analytically and in a regional model in which the equilibrium distributions of workers and sectors are demonstrated.
abstract_zh: 人们渴望前往就业机会所在地的想法直观易懂，但在标准的定量空间建模方法中却未得到体现，该方法中，位置选择由价格引导，而不考虑数量（即某地的就业岗位数量）。本文旨在填补这一空白，将工作岗位与地点一同作为家庭选择的客体。这需要对文献中使用的建模方法进行微调，并为劳动力市场匹配提供简洁描述。类似地，对企业选址建模的调整捕捉到了这一观念：企业选址既受工资成本影响，也受具备适当技能的劳动力可得性影响。这些调整产生了强大的集聚效应，因为工人的位置选择受到某地就业岗位数量的正向影响，而企业的决策则受具备适当技能工人数量的影响。研究结果通过解析方法及一个区域模型得以确立，在该模型中展示了工人与部门的均衡分布。
title: Location choice when the number of jobs matters: matching in spatial equilibrium
title_zh: 当工作数量重要时的区位选择：空间均衡中的匹配

abstract: Global food governance is increasingly described as being in crisis, as multilateral cooperation weakens amid rising nationalist and populist politics. However, less attention has been paid to how dominant multilateral modes of governance within the broader field of global governance shape the political conditions in which such tensions emerge. This paper examines how contemporary global food governance is organized primarily around coordination as a governing grammar—a mode of governing oriented toward aligning action across fragmented authority. Drawing on an interpretive analysis of a purposively selected body of authoritative global food governance documents produced between 2012 and 2025, the paper examines how coordination structures action, responsibility, evaluation, and contestation across multilateral institutions. The analysis identifies recurring patterns through which coordination diffuses responsibility, manages failure procedurally, and reframes distributive trade-offs as technical problems, enabling sustained engagement and institutional durability in the absence of centralized authority. These features constrain multilateral institutions’ capacity to assume responsibility, adjudicate conflicts, or respond politically to uneven consequences. Grievances associated with food system transformation often struggle to gain traction within multilateral arenas; this may contribute to their articulation in other political contexts, including national and subnational arenas where responsibility is more readily attributed. Rather than treating such mobilizations as external threats to multilateralism, these dynamics are interpreted as being consistent with the institutional features of coordination-based governance. The paper concludes by outlining implications for global food governance, emphasizing the need to complement coordination with institutional arrangements that clarify responsibility, link measurement to material response, and enable political contestation over distributive trade-offs.
abstract_zh: 全球粮食治理日益被描述为处于危机之中，因为在民族主义和民粹主义政治崛起的背景下，多边合作趋于弱化。然而，对于更广泛的全球治理领域中占主导地位的多边治理模式如何塑造此类紧张关系浮现的政治条件，关注尚显不足。本文考察当代全球粮食治理如何主要围绕“协调”这一治理语法加以组织——这是一种旨在跨碎片化权威对齐行动的治理模式。基于对2012年至2025年间有目的选取的权威全球粮食治理文件进行的解释性分析，本文考察协调如何跨多边机构构建行动、责任、评估与争议。分析识别出反复出现的模式，通过这些模式，协调分散责任、以程序化方式管理失败，并将分配性权衡重新框定为技术性问题，从而在缺乏中央权威的情况下实现持续参与和制度韧性。这些特征制约了多边机构承担责任、裁决冲突或对不均衡后果作出政治回应的能力。与粮食体系转型相关的不满往往难以在多边舞台上获得关注；这可能促使其在其他政治场域中得到表达，包括责任更易被归因的国家和次国家层面。与其将此类动员视为对多边主义的外部威胁，这些动态被解释为与基于协调的治理的制度特征相一致。本文最后概述了对全球粮食治理的启示，强调有必要以明确责任、将测量与实质性回应相挂钩，并允许对分配性权衡进行政治争议的制度安排来补充协调机制。
title: Beyond coordination: responsibility and the crisis of global food governance design
title_zh: 超越协调：责任与全球粮食治理设计的危机

abstract: This paper studies asset pricing under expectations‐based reference‐dependent preferences in a general equilibrium framework. We show that reference‐dependent preferences can generate self‐fulfilling risk panics, producing sentiment‐driven asset price fluctuations through a feedback loop between current prices and perceived future downside risk—dynamics impossible under standard expected utility. The model helps explain empirical puzzles including (i) excess volatility, (ii) asymmetric volatility, (iii) asymmetric sentiment over the business cycle, (iv) excess asset price comovement, and (v) weak correlations between stock returns and economic fundamentals, alongside a sizable equity premium. Additional empirical evidence based on closed‐end fund discounts and quantitative analysis support the theory.
abstract_zh: 本文在一般均衡框架下研究基于预期参照依赖偏好的资产定价问题。我们证明，参照依赖偏好能够引发自我实现的恐慌情绪，通过当前价格与感知的未来下行风险之间的反馈循环，产生由情绪驱动的资产价格波动——这种动态在标准期望效用下是不可能出现的。该模型有助于解释一系列实证谜团，包括（i）过度波动性，（ii）非对称波动性，（iii）商业周期中的非对称情绪，（iv）资产价格的过度联动，以及（v）股票回报与经济基本面之间的弱相关性，同时伴随显著的股权溢价。基于封闭式基金折价和定量分析的额外实证证据支持了这一理论。
title: Reference‐Dependent Preferences and Sentiment‐Driven Asset Prices
title_zh: 参考依赖偏好与情绪驱动的资产价格

abstract: We study the subtlety of optimal paternalism when a utilitarian planner has the power to design a discrete choice set for a heterogeneous population with bounded rationality. We first consider the planning problem in abstraction. We show that the policy that most effectively constrains or influences choices depends multiplicatively on the preferences of the population and the choice probabilities conditional on preferences that measure the suboptimality of behavior. We then study two settings in which the planner may mandate an action or decentralize decision making. One setting supposes that individuals measure utility with additive random error and maximize mismeasured rather than actual utility. Then optimal planning requires knowledge of the distribution of measurement errors. The other setting studies binary treatment choice when the planner can mandate a treatment conditional on publicly observed personal covariates or can enable individuals to choose their own treatments conditional on private information. Here we focus on situations where bounded rationality takes the form of deviations between subjective and objective probabilities of uncertain outcomes. To illustrate, we consider clinical decision making in medicine. In toto, our cautionary analysis shows that determination of optimal policy requires the planner to possess extensive knowledge that is rarely available. We warn that research in behavioral public economics should avoid overoptimistic claims regarding the nature of optimal paternalistic policies. We argue that credible study of utilitarian planning should consider not only the population but also the planner to be boundedly rational.
title: The subtlety of optimal paternalism in a population with bounded rationality
title_zh: 有限理性群体中最优家长式干预的微妙性

abstract: Livestock browsing is a significant driver of forest degradation, with major ecological consequences. In Chile, high livestock stocking densities (LSD) negatively impact on forests, yet their social determinants remain poorly understood. Based on 100 farms that are part of the National Forest Inventory Dataset (farm-level socioeconomic and biophysical data measured in both 2016 and 2022), semi-structured interviews and forest plots (species, sizes, health, and regeneration plots) were performed to evaluate the impact of livestock on forests, understand its socioeconomic drivers, and propose policies to better regulate this activity. We observed that livestock production was stable between 2016 and 2022, despite the huge impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on productive systems. LSD decreased when the importance of off-farm incomes increased. Forest cover was also relevant, as LSD increased in larger and more deforested farms. It means deforestation exacerbates animal load and its negative impacts on the remnant forest fragments. A high LSD decreases seedling and sapling abundance, and increases damage on them, even in farms with supplementary fodder supply. We also observed a significant correlation between damage on tree regeneration and low-quality adult-trees (shape, health and diversity), which exposes past impacts of livestock on forests. As livestock is stable along time, this correlation shows how livestock has been degrading previous tree-cohorts and modifying forest dynamic in a silent process, which exposes how important regulating animal load is for the future of Chilean forests. Finally, we develop several policy proposals to better regulate livestock and its negative impacts.
abstract_zh: 牲畜啃食是森林退化的重要驱动因素，具有重大生态后果。在智利，高牲畜放养密度（LSD）对森林产生负面影响，但其社会决定因素仍知之甚少。基于100个属于国家森林清查数据集（2016年和2022年两次测量的农场层面社会经济和生物物理数据）的农场，进行了半结构化访谈和森林样地（物种、大小、健康状况和更新样地）调查，以评估牲畜对森林的影响，理解其社会经济驱动因素，并提出政策以更好地规范这一活动。我们观察到，尽管COVID-19大流行对生产系统产生了巨大影响，2016年至2022年间畜牧业生产保持稳定。当非农收入的重要性增加时，LSD下降。森林覆盖率也具有相关性，因为在更大且更退化的农场中LSD增加。这意味着森林砍伐加剧了动物负荷及其对残余森林斑块的负面影响。高LSD降低了幼苗和幼树丰度，并增加了对其的损害，即使在提供补充饲料的农场中也是如此。我们还观察到树木更新损害与低质量成年树（形状、健康和多样性）之间存在显著相关性，这揭示了牲畜过去对森林的影响。由于畜牧业随时间保持稳定，这一相关性表明牲畜如何以无声过程持续退化先前的树木群体并改变森林动态，这凸显了调节动物负荷对智利森林未来的重要性。最后，我们提出了若干政策建议，以更好地规范畜牧业及其负面影响。
title: Socioeconomic drivers of livestock browsing, and its impact on Chilean forests
title_zh: 智利森林中牲畜啃食的社会经济驱动因素及其影响

abstract: Students with the same test score can have considerably different academic ranks depending on their school peers. Using data from the Mexico City metropolitan area, this column examines how differences relative academic ranks in elementary school affect later cognitive and noncognitive outcomes. Among students with similar third-grade scores, those with higher academic ranks performed better on their high school admission exams. The early ranks also shaped college aspirations and academic self-perceptions. Early academic ranks can be particularly consequential for students with fewer socioeconomic resources.
abstract_zh: 测试分数相同的学生，其学业排名可能因学校同伴不同而大相径庭。利用墨西哥城大都市区的数据，本文考察了小学阶段相对学业排名的差异如何影响后续的认知与非认知结果。在三年级成绩相近的学生中，学业排名较高者在高中入学考试中表现更佳。早期排名还塑造了大学志向与学业自我认知。对于社会经济资源较少的学生而言，早期学业排名的影响尤为显著。
authors: Eunsik Chang, Maria Padilla-Romo, Cecilia Peluffo
title: How early academic rank shapes high school choices and admissions
title_zh: 早期学术排名如何影响高中选择与录取

abstract: There are optimistic targets for phosphorus recycling from waste streams to solve environmental and supply issues simultaneously. The recycling process requires high energy inputs, thus the joint distribution of (input) energy and (output) fertilizer commodity prices is a crucial determinant of the profitability of investing. We propose a methodology to model the investment risk and price dependencies using quantile vector autoregression and copulas. Moreover, we show that standard approaches overestimate the variance of investment returns. Finally, we find that phosphorus recycling investments are only profitable with substantial subsidies or savings on disposal expenditures.
abstract_zh: 针对从废物流中回收磷以同时解决环境与供应问题的乐观目标，回收过程需要高能量投入，因此（投入）能源与（产出）肥料商品价格的联合分布是投资盈利性的关键决定因素。我们提出了一种方法，利用分位数向量自回归和连接函数来建模投资风险与价格依赖性。此外，我们表明标准方法高估了投资回报的方差。最后，我们发现磷回收投资仅在获得大量补贴或节省处置支出时才具有盈利性。
title: Commodity price risk in phosphorus recycling investments
title_zh: 磷回收投资中的商品价格风险
